req.title: Redirect-to accepts POST as well
req.statement: The system shall accept POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE on /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to handler accepts GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, and TRACE. Tests must verify: (1) each non-GET method returns a 3xx redirect with correct Location header (positive/EP), (2) unsupported methods return 405 (negative/NEG), (3) boundary status_code values at exactly 300 and 399 are accepted while 299 and 400 are not treated as redirect codes (BVA). The source reads 'url' from request.args (query string) for all methods, and sets status_code only when 300 <= code < 400. We must assert exact status codes and exact Location header values to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_post_redirect_to_returns_302_with_location
preconditions: POST method is listed in route methods
trace: R-HTTPBIN-028: POST on /redirect-to must be accepted and redirect
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_redirect_to_returns_302_with_location():
    r = client.post('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == 'http://example.com'

test_post_redirect_to_returns_302_with_location()

tests.name: test_all_required_methods_accepted_not_405
preconditions: All five non-GET methods must be in route
actions: Send POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, TRACE to /redirect-to?url=http://x.com
expected: All five methods return status code != 405
trace: R-HTTPBIN-028: all listed methods must be accepted (not 405)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_required_methods_accepted_not_405():
    url = 'http://x.com'
    methods_and_callers = [
        ('POST', client.post),
        ('PUT', client.put),
        ('DELETE', client.delete),
        ('PATCH', client.patch),
    ]
    for method_name, caller in methods_and_callers:
        r = caller(f'/redirect-to?url={url}')
        assert r.status_code != 405, f'{method_name} got 405'
        assert r.status_code == 302, f'{method_name} expected 302 got {r.status_code}'
        assert r.headers['Location'] == url, f'{method_name} bad Location'
    r = client.open(f'/redirect-to?url={url}', method='TRACE')
    assert r.status_code != 405
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == url

test_all_required_methods_accepted_not_405()
